source.citation: tan φ = v² / (g r_c): the lean that balances a steady turn, point mass on a massless leg (fidelity-gate §4.2 S1)
source.notes: Checks the implementation, not reality (fidelity-gate §2.2). r_c is fitted to the centre-of-mass path over the steady window, v is centre-of-mass speed; φ is state.lean. Speed decays during the window because nothing pushes; the relation is evaluated per tick and averaged. One foot, shallow edge.
